title: TransXplainRRG: A Radiologist-Evaluated LVLM for Chest Radiograph Report Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.16393v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLM) enhance X-ray report generation, but often neglect clinical context, overlook workflow integration, and lack explainability, which hinders clinical adoption due to interpretability and reliability concerns. This paper addresses the dual challenges of performance and expert explainability in automated X-ray report generation for clinical AI applications. Our proposed approach, TransXplainRRG, utilises an off-the-shelf Swin Transformer model along with a transformer-based text encoder that incorporates patient medical history to generate a radiology report. Further, we explore an expert-guided `inside-out' approach and extract only abnormal findings for radiology report refinement. translated_title: TransXplainRRG：一个经放射科医师评估的用于胸部X光片报告生成的大型视觉语言模型
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的最新进展提升了X光报告生成的质量，但这些模型往往忽视临床背景、忽略工作流程集成，且缺乏可解释性，这导致其在可解释性和可靠性方面的顾虑阻碍了临床应用。本文解决了临床AI应用中自动化X光报告生成所面临的性能与专家可解释性的双重挑战。我们提出的方法TransXplainRRG利用现成的Swin Transformer模型以及融合患者病史的基于Transformer的文本编码器来生成放射学报告。此外，我们探索了一种由专家指导的“由内而外”（inside-out）方法，仅提取异常发现用于放射学报告的优化。因此，本研究通过结合最先进的基于Transformer的视觉编码器、文本编码器，弥合了高性能自动化与临床实践中至关重要的可解释性之间的差距。
tldr: TransXplainRRG结合Swin Transformer视觉编码器、融合患者病史的文本编码器以及专家指导的“由内而外”异常发现提取方法，实现了高性能且可解释的胸部X光报告自动生成，并经放射科医师评估验证。
en_tdlr: TransXplainRRG combines a Swin Transformer vision encoder, a text encoder incorporating patient medical history, and an expert-guided "inside-out" abnormality extraction approach to achieve high-performance and explainable chest radiograph report generation, validated through radiologist evaluation.
